d: As a Senior Compliance Analyst at Deriv, you'll safeguard our business and clients by driving a strong culture of compliance across our operations. Your analytical expertise ensures internal processes meet regulatory and policy requirements, while reinforcing the integrity of our business practices. Using advanced, AI-enhanced tools, you'll strengthen our ability to assess issues, support effective decision-making, and contribute to lasting improvements across the organisation.

Deriv's mission is Trading for Anyone, Anywhere, Anytime. Real money, real regulations, real consequences. Every jurisdiction has different rules, every trade needs monitoring, and manual review doesn't scale to the volume we run at.

We're building continuous monitoring, automated screening, and audit trails that hold up to regulatory scrutiny—because they're more consistent than checking things by hand. You'll work inside those systems, using AI-enhanced tooling to assess issues faster and go deeper than a spreadsheet ever could.
q: You've done this at regulated scale.A university degree in finance, economics, law, risk management, criminology, business studies, data science, management, or a related field, plus 5+ years of compliance experience in financial services, fintech, investment services, or another regulated environment.

You know what "compliant" actually requires. Strong knowledge of regulatory requirements and industry standards, with real experience in customer due diligence, transaction reviews, and sanctions screening—not just training on them.
You find the pattern in the noise. Strong analytical skills for spotting anomalies in transaction data, comfortable in Excel and with complex datasets.
You write and speak with precision. Clear English, meticulous attention to detail, and the judgment to make sound calls on limited information without cutting corners on compliance standards.

You act with integrity when no one's checking. Reliable, self-motivated, and adaptable when priorities shift—and genuinely interested in what AI tools can do for compliance work, not just tolerant of them.
You can hold a hard conversation. The confidence and professionalism to push back on operational or product teams when their plan doesn't meet the standard.

You'll own calls where getting it wrong means regulatory exposure, not just an unhappy customer. You'll balance thoroughness against operational speed, and you'll need to defend a judgment call to people—internal teams, auditors, sometimes regulators—who weren't in the room when you made it.

But you'll build compliance that actually works at scale: consistent, defensible, and backed by tools that catch what manual review misses. You'll be the person other teams come to when a compliance question doesn't have an obvious answer.
If you want a checklist role, this isn't it. If you want ownership over real risk decisions, it might be.
r: Account & Transaction Investigation — Analysing flagged accounts and transaction activity to identify compliance concerns
Customer Due Diligence — Running comprehensive customer reviews against internal policy and regulatory requirements
High-Value Transaction Review — Assessing large deposits and withdrawals through AI-powered review procedures
Screening & Reporting — PEP, sanctions, and adverse media screening, plus internal reporting and regulatory filing support
Investigate flagged client accounts by analysing transactions and account activity to identify compliance concerns others might miss.
Carry out comprehensive customer reviews and due diligence checks, and make the call on adherence to internal policy and regulatory requirements.
Assess high-value deposit and withdrawal requests by reviewing transaction histories and applying internal review procedures through AI-powered tools.
Screen clients against PEP lists, global sanctions databases, and adverse media—and decide when a hit is noise versus signal.
Prepare compliance reports that stand up to scrutiny, and support regulatory filings where required.
Work directly with operational and product teams to explain what compliance actually requires and where their process needs to change.
Spot where a compliance process is weaker than it should be, and help fix it—not just flag it.
Give a clear, defensible answer on complex compliance questions when the rest of the team isn't sure.

d: talabat runs its online branding for top funnel campaigns in house in Dubai. We are looking for a hands-on individual contributor to plan, execute and report on our top of funnel online advertising across the region. You will work on the platforms every day and own campaigns end to end ie from brief to post campaign analysis. You will also align closely with Delivery Hero and the wider performance team, so that brand and performance work together.
This role is designed to grow. Around 12 months into the role, it will evolve into audio visual planning, powered by ad tech, so that you can plan holistically across all audio visual platforms.
Build top of funnel media plans from brand briefs. This covers objectives, audiences, platform mix, budgets, flighting, and reach and frequency targets.
Recommend the right platform and format for each campaign objective, such as awareness, reach, video views and consideration.
Build audience strategies using first party, contextual and platform native targeting.
Plan across DV360, Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, YouTube, Over the Top (OTT) and programmatic Digital Out of Home (DOOH).
Coordinate with Delivery Hero and the performance team on shared audiences, calendars, budgets and learnings, to avoid overlap and make sure brand supports performance.
Set up, launch, optimise and close campaigns in each platform's native tools, with no reliance on agency intermediaries. This covers DV360, Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, YouTube and OTT.

Execute programmatic DOOH campaigns where possible. This is a plus rather than a requirement, and we will support you to build this skill. It includes setting up location, time and context triggered buys, selecting venues and screen types, managing pacing and creative rotation, and verifying delivery with partners.
Manage budgets and pacing daily, and adjust bids, placements, creatives and audiences to hit KPIs.
Run brand safety, viewability, fraud and frequency controls, including across programmatic and OTT inventory.
Brief creative teams on specs, formats and platform best practices. Run creative testing and rotation.
Manage trafficking, tagging and tracking, and coordinate with partners and publishers on DOOH and OTT buys.
Troubleshoot delivery and technical issues quickly.
Build and maintain dashboards and regular reports covering reach, frequency, CPM, VTR, CPV, attention and brand lift.
Run brand lift studies and measurement partnerships. Turn the results into clear recommendations.
Write post campaign reports that explain what worked and what did not, and what we should do next.
Share platform and channel learnings with the wider marketing, brand and performance teams.
Work with Brand, Marketing, Creative, Finance and Regional teams to agree briefs, timelines and approvals.
Act as the day to day media partner for each talabat market. Understand local priorities, calendars and audience needs, and translate them into effective plans.
Build and maintain strong, trusted relationships with market teams, so they feel supported, informed and involved in decisions.
Hit campaign launch dates, reporting deadlines and budget sign off cycles reliably.
Raise risks early and escalate blockers to the Head of Brand Media.
Work with platform and vendor representatives to get access to betas, support and commercial benefits.
Move from channel level planning to holistic audio visual planning across online video, social video, OTT, connected TV, digital audio and programmatic DOOH.

Use ad tech to plan and optimise across platforms. This includes planning and buying platforms, audience and identity tools, cross platform reach and frequency measurement, and automation and data tooling.
Build a unified view of audience, reach, frequency and attention across audio visual platforms, to improve efficiency and avoid duplicated reach.
Help shape talabat's audio visual planning approach, tools and ways of working, working with the Head of Brand Media, Delivery Hero and the performance team.
q: Proven experience in digital media, ideally on the brand or awareness side, at a client, platform or agency.
Hands-on experience in DV360, Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads Manager, Snapchat Ads Manager and Google Ads for YouTube.
Working knowledge of OTT buying and measurement.
Plus: hands-on experience executing programmatic DOOH, for example through DV360 or a DOOH specific platform, including venue selection, audience and location triggers, and delivery verification.
Strong understanding of reach and frequency, viewability, brand safety, attention and brand lift measurement.
Interest in ad tech and cross platform planning, and the curiosity to learn new tools quickly as the role evolves.
Comfortable with data. Advanced Excel or Google Sheets is required. Looker Studio, Tableau or SQL is a plus.
Self sufficient, with strong organisation, attention to detail and the ability to hold deadlines across many concurrent campaigns without a team behind you.
Clear communicator who builds relationships easily and is comfortable with senior stakeholders and market teams.
Experience in the MENA region, and in food, delivery, quick commerce or consumer apps, is a plus.
Fluency in English is required. Arabic is a plus.
x: Talabat is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.
